checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Deliverable is the kitchen-table video with audible voice-over, not audio-only
must.why: The output is a 10 s video of the same kitchen and woman with moving lips, plus a separate WAV. Whether the video's own track is audible can't be checked.

must.item: Narration says the supplied script exactly
must.why: The final audio was not available. The mp3s are voice previews only.

must.item: Entire narration intelligible and finishes before 10 s
must.why: The lips move at 1, 4 and 7 s. At 9.5 s the mouth is closed and she is smiling, which suggests speech ended. Intelligibility can't be checked.
The kitchen, framing, clothing and the person are the same in all frames. Only the mouth and gestures differ.

must.item: No music or added on-screen text
must.why: No captions or overlays appear in any frame. Music can't be heard, but none was requested.

exact_text.text: Make mornings easier: prepare your clothes, pack your bag, and plan breakfast the night before. Start tomorrow with less stress.
exact_text.read_as: No on-screen text, as requested. The words are spoken audio, which could not be checked.

faults.what: The face looks a little soft or smoothed in some frames, which is typical of lip-sync output. No obvious warping.

summary: The 10 s kitchen clip came out clean, with natural lip movement, no text and unchanged framing. The spoken words and timing could not be verified.
